description: Create a task on Runrun.it in board Ongoing (ID: 96356) in column Task by default and assignee from who is call the tool. Requires title (eg.: [project_name] - task_name) and type_id. Optional: description (rich description via Task Description API, appended to any existing text), project_id, assignments, desired_date, etc.

description.description: Task description body (optional). Stored via PUT /tasks/:id/description after create; new text is appended after any content already on the task, never replacing it outright.

name: runrunit_create_task
